parsed.doc_summary: Cal. Gov. Code § 12955 (FEHA housing discrimination), as amended by SB 267 effective 2024-01-01. Relevant to screening restrictions: source-of-income discrimination ban, including Section 8 and HUD-VASH vouchers, plus credit-history/alternative-evidence rules for subsidized tenants.

rules.title: FEHA housing discrimination: source of income protections
rules.requirement: Landlords may not discriminate against or harass applicants or tenants based on source of income, including housing vouchers like Section 8 and HUD-VASH. For subsidized tenants, income standards must be based on the tenant's portion of rent, and applicants must be allowed to offer alternative evidence in place of credit history. Landlords may still ask about the level or source of income.
rules.quoted_span: For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.effective_date_note: Effective date of the SB 267 amendment (Stats. 2023, Ch. 776), which expanded source of income to include HUD-VASH vouchers and added the subsection (o) credit-history provisions. Source of income was already in the statute before then.
rules.key_value: ban on source-of-income discrimination incl. Section 8 and HUD-VASH vouchers
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to owners of housing accommodations generally.
